author: Madrang
install_msg: Installed FeedWatch from [RedCogs repository](https://github.com/madrang/RedCogs). Load the cog, set a channel with `[p]setchannel`, and add feeds with `[p]addsrc`
name: FeedWatch
short: Watch feed URLs and auto-post new entries to a channel.
description: Polls watch-listed URLs every 5 minutes and posts new entries as embeds to a configured channel. Each watch URL must return a JSON array of posts (id, title, link or url, excerpt or description; plain strings or WordPress-style rendered objects).
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users.
